committed namespace, regular-file, replay, corruption, migration and downgrade rules remain unchanged
survivingDecision.backendSelection: explicitly qualified writer backend; never per-write silent fallback
survivingDecision.mixedWriterRuleUntilQualified: homogeneous writer backend or quiesced/fenced switch for one writable journal namespace
